title: RLHF: How AI Learns Good Manners

scenes.text: Ask a raw language model a question, and it might ramble, or say something rude. [1] So how did chatbots become so helpful and polite? [2] The answer is RLHF, reinforcement learning from human feedback.
RLHF means training an AI using human preferences. [1] Humans compare the AI's answers, [2] a reward model learns what humans like, [3] and the AI practises until it earns high rewards.

data.definition: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback: training an AI to give the kinds of answers people prefer.

scenes.text: Here are the steps. [1] Start with a pretrained model, from episode 7. [2] Fine-tune it on good example answers, written by people. [3] Then the model writes two answers to the same question, and a person picks the better one. [4] Thousands of these choices train a reward model. [5] Finally, reinforcement learning makes the AI chase high reward scores.

The key moment is the comparison. [1] Answer A is short, clear, and polite. [2] Answer B is long, confusing, and a little rude. [3] The person picks A. It's much easier to choose the better answer than to write a perfect one.

Remember reinforcement learning from episode 24? [1] Here, the AI writes an answer, [2] the reward model scores it, [3] and the AI adjusts itself. [4] Over many rounds, it learns to be helpful, honest, and harmless.

Here are four terms. [1] Preference data, the A or B choices people made. [2] The reward model, a model that scores answers the way people would. [3] Alignment, making AI behave the way we intend. [4] And DPO, a newer, simpler method that learns straight from preferences, without a separate reward model.

Here's a common myth. [1] People think RLHF teaches the AI new facts. [2] Mostly, it doesn't. The knowledge comes from pretraining. RLHF shapes behaviour, like tone, helpfulness, and saying no to harmful requests.

data.myth: RLHF teaches the AI new facts.
data.fact: Knowledge mostly comes from pretraining. RLHF shapes behaviour: tone, helpfulness and refusing harm.

data.question: In RLHF, humans mainly…
